messages:
sara.sales: POC kickoff for ClientCo. They want Private (VPC) on-prem with customer-managed keys/HSM. They need a secure, offline cert/key exchange and attestation this week.
Samantha (ClientCo): Security requires HSM-backed KEKs (FIPS 140-2/3), customer holds master keys. No private keys may traverse the internet. Need attestation cert and a rotation plan.
julia.sec: We support three flows for Private deployments: BYOK (CSR/public-key upload), KMS integration (AWS/GCP/Azure), or PKCS#11 HSM adapter for on-prem. In all cases Redwood never stores raw private keys.
julia.sec: BYOK CSR flow (recommended if they want to manage keys locally): customer generates keypair locally (RSA 4096 or ECDSA P-384), provides CSR or just the public key. We return a signed cert for them to install. Example: 
``
openssl req -new -newkey rsa:4096 -nodes -keyout clientco_poc.key -out clientco_poc.csr -subj "/CN=clientco-poc/O=ClientCo"
```
We also accept PEM or DER.
aditya.eng: For infra: we can do air-gapped deployment inside their VPC or via VPC peering. For receiving certs we can provision a one-time secure upload (expiring SFTP drop) or a signed, single-use HTTPS upload token. We will not request private keys.
aditya.eng: What we need from ClientCo to provision: 1) chosen pattern (BYOK / KMS integration / PKCS#11), 2) CSR or KMS identifier (e.g., arn:aws:kms:...), 3) node FQDNs for SANs, 4) key custodian contact + PGP pubkey if they want encrypted metadata.
Samantha (ClientCo): We will use CloudHSM. Rotation cadence: quarterly. We need proof of attestation for the HSM and a documented rotation procedure. Also who hosts CRL/OCSP?
julia.sec: For CloudHSM we accept vendor attestation cert chains. Rotation options: (A) customer rotates keys inside HSM and provides new public key/CSR to us; (B) if you give read-only KMS API access we can fetch public key versions. Switchover is rolling: warm caches, reload certs, restart worker processes with zero-downtime pattern.
julia.sec: Revocation: customers usually host CRL/OCSP endpoints. We can be configured to query your OCSP responder or fetch CRL. Alternatively we offer a webhook to publish revocation events to your endpoint.
Samantha (ClientCo): For offline exchange: exact file formats? sample CSR with SANs?
aditya.eng: Preferred formats: PEM (preferred) and DER. Example openssl config for SANs: 
``
[req]
distinguished_name = req_distinguished_name
req_extensions = v3_req
[req_distinguished_name]
[ v3_req ]
subjectAltName = @alt_names
[alt_names]
DNS.1 = app.clientco.internal
DNS.2 = api.clientco.internal
```
Then: 
``
openssl req -new -key clientco_poc.key -out clientco_poc.csr -config csr_openssl.cnf
```
We can accept the csr.pem via SFTP drop.
julia.sec: Short security checklist for POC: - HSM vendor + attestation cert chain - key algorithm & size - rotation policy & window - key custodian + MFA and separation of duties - network topology (air-gapped / peered) - SAN list for certs - signed NDA / ATO paperwork (if required)
sara.sales: I'll DM the upload link and schedule a 30m handoff tomorrow @ 10am PT. aditya/julia please join.
aditya.eng: sgtm. I'll bring the deployment runbook and SFTP instructions.
julia.sec: I'll bring the security checklist and a sample key-handling SLA.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: POC-4729 — Private POC: ClientCo CloudHSM onboarding (assignee: aditya.eng).
sara.sales: Thanks everyone, will follow up after the handoff.
